issues.description: When include_router recreates an API route, the already-derived stream_item_type is not forwarded to the new route. The recreated route resets stream_item_type to None and can no longer rederive it from the endpoint annotation because the response model state has already changed from the initial DefaultPlaceholder. Runtime streaming continues to work, but the OpenAPI schema loses typed stream item information: SSE itemSchema loses contentSchema/contentMediaType and JSONL itemSchema degrades to empty or missing.
issues.repair_unit: propagate the already-derived stream_item_type when include_router recreates an API route instead of resetting that derived route metadata
issues.mechanism_pattern: include_router recreates a route without forwarding its precomputed stream_item_type; the recreated route resets it to None and can no longer rederive it from the endpoint annotation because the response model state has already changed
issues.invariant_pattern: route cloning and router inclusion must preserve derived route metadata required for downstream runtime/schema behavior
